prompt: A savings account grows by $8\%$ each year. What is the growth factor you multiply by each year? (For example, up $5\%$ is $1.05$.)
hint: You keep everything you had — that is $100\%$ — and then add more.

hints.text: You keep everything you had — that is $100\%$ — and then add more.

explanation: Growing by $8\%$ means you keep all $100\%$ AND gain $8\%$ more.
Together that is $108\%$ of what you had.

alternativeExplanations.title: Try it on \$100
steps: Put $\$100$ in. Eight percent of $\$100$ is $\$8$.
